title: Incremental schema translation hub with WASM transforms for SDK/CLI/API telemetry
creator: Miguel Rivera
description: Build a lightweight, central "translation hub" service that enables incremental schema evolution for telemetry emitted by SDKs, CLI, and API clients without requiring coordinated client upgrades. The hub will operate as an ingress/egress layer in the Console backend and the analytics pipeline: it validates incoming event envelopes, performs version-aware transformations, annotates provenance for downstream analytics, and provides a safe canary rollout path for schema changes. Key innovations: (1) compile per-version transformation logic as sandboxed WASM modules to avoid frequent server code deploys, (2) express canonical shape with JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) + semantic versioning in envelope header x-redwood-schema-version, (3) maintain a signed transform registry (S3 + manifest + KMS signing) for verified module distribution, (4) route and sample traffic for staged migration (0.1% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%), and (5) provide an operator UI in Console for monitoring translation errors and forcing fallbacks. This ticket covers design, prototyping the WASM transform runtime, validation harnesses, and the staging rollout plan for the analytics ingestion pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Translation hub service deployed in staging that accepts existing telemetry envelopes with header x-redwood-schema-version and emits normalized canonical events to the analytics Kafka topic
WASM transform runtime can load, validate signature, and execute a sample transform with <10ms median execution for cached modules
Automatic fallback path: when transform fails or signature invalid, original raw event is forwarded to a quarantine topic and an alert is raised; failure rate must remain <0.1% in canary runs
End-to-end staging test that replays 48h of production telemetry through the hub and produces identical analytics aggregates (within 0.5%) for non-upgraded fields
Operator Console dashboard shows translation success rate, latency P50/P95, and per-module error traces; retention for 30d
Runbook documented: step-by-step rollback for translations and playbook for missing-field regressions
Security review completed and signed off for WASM runtime and transform registry (KMS key usage and manifest signing)
